# 💬 Support for CubicLM

> Need help with **CubicLM** (`com.cubiclm.app` v1.1.0) — AI chat with local `llama.cpp` / `LiteRT-LM` / `SD 1.5` and 18 cloud providers?

## 📋 Before You Ask

- [ ] Search [existing issues](https://github.com/abir2afridi/CubicLM/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/abir2afridi/CubicLM/discussions)
- [ ] Read [README](https://github.com/abir2afridi/CubicLM#readme) — Features, Tech Stack, Project Structure, Getting Started, Release Build
- [ ] Check [docs/BUILD_AND_RUN.md](../docs/BUILD_AND_RUN.md) for clone → `flutter pub get` → `flutter run` / `flutter build` (including `C:\CLM` junction for paths with spaces, JDK 17, `nuget.exe`, ATL headers)
- [ ] Check [docs/PLATFORM_DIFFERENCES.md](../docs/PLATFORM_DIFFERENCES.md) and [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [ ] See [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) for version history and known limitations (Web `dart:ffi` in v1.1.0)
- [ ] Run `flutter doctor -v` and check **Nodes → Config → System Logs** for diagnostics

## 🚀 Where to Get Help

| Need | Channel | When to use |
|------|---------|-------------|
| 💬 Questions, ideas, show & tell | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/abir2afridi/CubicLM/discussions) | **Preferred for usage questions** — fastest community response |
| 🐛 Bug reports | [Issue forms](https://github.com/abir2afridi/CubicLM/issues/new/choose) | Choose 🐛 Bug Report / 📱 Mobile Bug / 🔧 Build Failure etc. |
| ✨ Feature requests | [Issue forms](https://github.com/abir2afridi/CubicLM/issues/new/choose) | Use ✨ Feature Request |
| 🔒 Security issues | **Private** — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) | Never in a public issue |
| 📖 Docs fixes | [Issue forms](https://github.com/abir2afridi/CubicLM/issues/new/choose) | Use 📝 Documentation Issue or open a PR |

## 🌐 Environment Checklist for Support Requests

When asking for help, include:

- **CubicLM version** — e.g., `v1.1.0+6` (from **App Settings → app info** or `pubspec.yaml:4`)
- **Platform** — Android (APK) / Windows (`cubiclm.exe`) / Web
- **Flutter** — `flutter --version` and `flutter doctor -v`
- **Java** — `java -version` (must be JDK 17 for `flutter build apk`)
- **Device** — SoC/GPU from **Nodes → Config → System Diagnostics** if relevant (e.g., Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, Tensor G3)

## ⏱️ Response Time

This is a community-maintained open-source project. Maintainers aim to triage issues within a few days. Discussions may get community answers faster.

## 🙏 How to Help Others

- Answer questions in Discussions
- Reproduce and confirm bugs
- Improve docs — even a one-line `docs/PLATFORM_LINKS.md` fix helps

Thank you for being part of the CubicLM community.
